text_en: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the exiles of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
text_cn: 耶稣基督的宗徒伯多禄致书给散居在本都、迦拉达、卡帕多细雅、亚细亚和彼提尼雅作旅客的选民：

text_en: who have been chosen and destined by God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit to be obedient to Jesus Christ and to be sprinkled with his blood: May grace and peace be yours in abundance.
text_cn: 你们被召选，是照天主的预定；受圣神祝圣，是为服事耶稣基督，和分沾他宝血洗净之恩。愿恩宠和平安丰富地赐予你们！

text_en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By his great mercy he has given us a new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
text_cn: 愿我们的主耶稣基督的天主和父受赞美！他因自己的大仁慈，藉耶稣基督由死者中的复活，重生了我们，为获得那充满生命的希望，

text_en: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, kept in heaven for you,
text_cn: 为获得那为你们已存留在天上的不坏、无瑕、不朽的产业，

text_en: who are being protected by the power of God through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
text_cn: 因为你们原是为天主的能力所保护，为使你们藉着信德，而获得那已准备好，在最后时期出现的救恩。

text_en: In this you rejoice, even if now for a little while you have had to suffer various trials,
text_cn: 为此，你们要欢跃，虽然如今你们暂时还该在各种试探中受苦，

text_en: so that the genuineness of your faith—being more precious than gold that, though perishable, is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.
text_cn: 这是为使你们的信德，得以精炼，比经过火炼而仍易消失的黄金，更有价值，好在耶稣基督显现时，堪受称赞、光荣和尊敬。

text_en: Although you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you do not see him now, you believe in him and rejoice with an indescribable and glorious joy,
text_cn: 你们虽然没有见过他，却爱慕他；虽然你们如今仍看不见他，还是相信他；并且以不可言传，和充满光荣的喜乐而欢跃，

text_en: for you are receiving the outcome of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
text_cn: 因为你们已把握住信仰的效果：灵魂的救恩。

text_en: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who prophesied of the grace that was to be yours made careful search and inquiry,
text_cn: 关于这救恩，那些预言了你们要得恩宠的先知们，也曾经寻求过，考究过，

text_en: inquiring about the person or time that the Spirit of Christ within them indicated when it testified in advance to the sufferings destined for Christ and the subsequent glory.
text_cn: 就是考究那在他们内的基督的圣神，预言那要临于基督的苦难，和以后的光荣时，指的是什么时期，或怎样的光景。

text_en: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you, in regard to the things that have now been announced to you through those who brought you good news by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things into which angels long to look!
text_cn: 这一切给他们启示出来，并不是为他们自己，而是为给你们服务；这一切，如今藉着给你们宣传福音的人，依赖由天上派遣来的圣神，传报给你们；对于这一切奥迹，连众天使也都切望窥探。

text_en: Therefore prepare your minds for action; discipline yourselves; set all your hope on the grace that Jesus Christ will bring you when he is revealed.
text_cn: 为此，你们要束上腰，谨守心神，要清醒，要全心希望在耶稣基督显现时，给你们带来的恩宠；

text_en: Like obedient children, do not be conformed to the desires that you formerly had in ignorance.
text_cn: 要做顺命的子女，不要符合你们昔日在无知中生活的欲望，

text_en: Instead, as he who called you is holy, be holy yourselves in all your conduct;
text_cn: 但要像那召叫你们的圣者一样，在一切生活上是圣的，

text_en: for it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy. ”
text_cn: 因为经上记载：“你们应是圣的，因为我是圣的。”

text_en: If you invoke as Father the one who judges all people impartially according to their deeds, live in reverent fear during the time of your exile.
text_cn: 你们既称呼那不看情面，而只按每人的作为行审判者为父，就该怀着敬畏，度过你们这旅居的时期。

text_en: You know that you were ransomed from the futile ways inherited from your ancestors, not with perishable things like silver or gold,
text_cn: 该知道：你们不是用能朽坏的金银等物，由你们祖传的虚妄生活中被赎出来的，

text_en: but with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without defect or blemish.
text_cn: 而是用宝血，即无玷无瑕的羔羊基督的宝血。

text_en: He was destined before the foundation of the world, but was revealed at the end of the ages for your sake.
text_cn: 他固然是在创世以前就被预定了的，但在最末的时期为了你们才出现，

text_en: Through him you have come to trust in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope are set on God.
text_cn: 为使你们因着他，而相信那使他由死者中复活，并赐给他光荣的天主：这样你们的信德和望德，都同归于天主。

text_en: Now that you have purified your souls by your obedience to the truth so that you have genuine mutual love, love one another deeply from the heart.
text_cn: 你们既因服从真理，而洁净了你们的心灵，获得了真实无伪的弟兄之爱，就该以赤诚的心，热切相爱，

text_en: You have been born anew, not of perishable but of imperishable seed, through the living and enduring word of God.
text_cn: 因为你们原是赖天主生活而永存的圣言，不是由于能坏的，而是由于不能坏的种子，得以重生。

text_en: For “All flesh is like grass and all its glory like the flower of grass. The grass withers, and the flower falls,
text_cn: 因为“凡有血肉的都似草，他的一切美丽都似草上的花：草枯萎了，花也就凋谢了；

text_en: but the word of the Lord endures forever. ” That word is the good news that was announced to you.
text_cn: 但上主的话却永远常存”:这话就是传报给你们的福音。
